changes.oldText: Superadmins have a Dashboard entry in the administration sidebar, showing a board of system-wide cards: Session Status, Pending Sessions and Reasons, Session Launches, Agents, Agent Statistics, Deployments, Audit Log: Top Failure Causes, Failures by Entity Type, Audit Log, Total Resources in Resource Group, Sessions Created, and Folders by Usage Mode. More cards, such as Scheduling Failures, Resource Policies, Failed sign-ins, Container Registries, and Sessions by Status, can be added from the edit sidebar.

changes.oldText: On the System Settings tab, superadmins set the options the WebUI offers to every user in the domain, such as the available sign-in options, session creation options, and sidebar menus. Click Apply to save the changed values; Reset deletes every value saved for the domain, returning each setting to its default. JSON Config shows the current settings as JSON, and can export them to a file or import one.
changes.newText: On the System Settings tab, superadmins set the options the WebUI offers to every user in the domain, such as the available sign-in options, session creation options, and sidebar menus. A value you change is saved right away and applies to every user; Reset deletes every value saved for the domain, returning each setting to its default. JSON Config shows the current settings as JSON, and can export them to a file or import one.

changes.newText: App Config: Checks that the app config entries registered on the server match what the WebUI expects. Repair App Config registers the missing entries, corrects wrong ranks, and purges unexpected entries together with the settings saved under them.
